responsibility: Implements Graphite’s polyhedral data-dependence analysis for a detected SCoP using isl. It converts each polyhedral data reference in the SCoP into constrained isl read, must-write, and may-write union maps over statement domains and subscript bounds, then asks isl to compute flow relations and stores the resulting combined dependence relation on the scop. It also provides the schedule-sensitive carries_deps helper that tests whether a given scheduling dimension carries dependences, which is used to reason about parallelizability and legality of transformed schedules.
